title: Log Rolling
tagline: Keep your feet. Tip your rival.
description: A balance duel from the logging traditions of Canada and the United States. Lean against every slip, kick the log at the right moment and tip your rival into the water across four ponds, from a still dawn mill pond to white-water rapids.
howToPlay: Drag on the pad to lean against a slip and keep your balance.
Tap the left or right half of the pad to kick the log.
A kick tips your rival; your own feet go with the log.
Stand steady to fill momentum: a kick costs about a third.
Win two of three bouts. Use Think for a hint.
